messages:
Jordan: Quick heads up — running ~10m late, my laptop camera just died. Can we swap the agenda: put Q&A first and push roadmap to after break?
Anya: Yep that's fine from comms side. I'll update the slide deck order.
SamM: If anyone on stage needs to hop to a backup laptop, the HDMI room jack is free. @Jordan, want me to set up a spare? :thumbsup:
Jordan: Yes please @SamM — if you can bring the spare and swap to the house cam that works.
RecordingBot: Recording started for #all-hands at 2026-03-23T16:02:25Z :red_circle:
Jordan: Also noting OBS kept dropping frames when I tried 1080p. Eng-Infra, any quick suggestions?
OpsBot: Ingest metrics show 4% packet loss from office network at 16:01. Recommend switching to backup RTMP (us-west-backup).
SamM: For hosts — quick fallback instructions:
```
1) OBS: Settings -> Stream -> Service: Custom
   Server: rtmp://backup.redwood.tv/live
   Stream Key: ask @OpsBot in DM
2) Restart OBS if frames stuck:
   pkill -f obs || true
   nohup obs > /tmp/obs.log 2>&1 &
```
SamM: I'll bring the spare laptop and an HDMI -> USB capture if needed.
Patrick: @LizH — leadership Q: if we start with Q&A do you want the roadmap slides shortened? I can do a condensed 8-min version.
LizH: Yes please condense to 8m and keep the top 3 priorities. We can drop the backlog deep-dive to the follow-up doc.
Dana: I'll pin a roadmap-summary doc in #all-hands and add the follow-up link for folks after.
Jordan: Thanks everyone. @RecordingBot can you flag the recording to note there was an agenda swap?
RecordingBot: Noted: metadata: agenda_swapped=true; original_order=Roadmap->Q&A; swapped_by=Jordan
Anya: Quick ops question — do we need to notify external partners about the time shift? Only if >15m.
Jordan: We'll be under 10m, no external pings.
Patrick: All set on my end. @SamM LMK if you want me to man the slides while you swap laptops.
SamM: I'll handle the swap, Patrick take slides please.
Jordan: Starting in ~8m. If anyone sees the stream buffering, post here and @OpsBot will force-failover.
OpsBot: Will monitor — will trigger failover at first sign of >10% packet loss.
Dana: After the meeting I'll upload the short Q&A transcript and action items.
LizH: Thanks team — we'll kick off with the Q&A and then run the 8m roadmap. :raised_hands:
